title: Vijnana Aranya, T.S. Subbanna Smaraka School and Sadvidya PU College, Mysuru
location: Mysuru (T.S. Subbanna Smaraka Girls' High School and Sadvidya PU College)
teaser: Vijnana Aranya at two Mysuru venues: talks by Ms. Nemichandra on preeminent women mathematicians, and Kanakanadalli Ganitha by Harsha.
homepageMatter: On 20 December 2025, tAcT conducted a Vijnana Aranya at two venues in Mysuru. Ms. Nemichandra spoke on preeminent women mathematicians (Hypatia to Maryam Mirzakhani) for high school and PU students, and Harsha presented Kanakanadalli Ganitha for 8th grade students.
